page.overview:
Who is Finn the Human?

Finn the Human is an Adventure Time minifigure released in 2016 as part of LEGO Dimensions.

Finn is the last human in the land of Ooo, who was raised by the dogs Joshua and Margaret. Now he fights injustice in Ooo alongside his adopted brother Jake the Dog.

Finn the Human is a purchasable skin in-game for 1,500 V-Bucks or with the Adventure Time Bundle for 3,800 V-Bucks.
